title: Jhund
desc: Vijay Barse, a retired teacher, builds a football team for slum kids to keep them away from crime. He works hard to help them join a national tournament and chase their dreams.

title: Srinivasa Kalyanam
desc: Srinivasa Kalyanam illustrates the sacred bond with another human through nuptial rituals and the sanctity of the institution of marriage.

title: Kabir Singh
desc: Brilliant surgeon Kabir and student Preeti face family opposition when their secret romance is discovered. Marriage looms.

title: Golimaar
desc: An 'encounter specialist' police officer becomes famous for killing criminals and finds himself targeted by gangsters and corrupt officers.

title: Satyamev Jayate 2
desc: Satya's anti-corruption bill fails, echoing his father's past. A vigilante targets corrupt officials, leading to Jay, his twin brother, an officer, on the case. A clash of justice looms.
